label: School identifier
definition: Retained 12-character school linkage key. Read as text to preserve leading zeros.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: School name
definition: Retained school name; no new name correction in this package.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: State or DC
definition: Two-letter state abbreviation; DC is a separate state-level jurisdiction.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: County GEOID
definition: Retained five-character county geography key; preserve leading zeros.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Administering LEA identifier
definition: Seven-character CRDC local education agency key; not a newly assigned geographic containing district.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: School locale
definition: City, Suburb, Town, Rural; retained coding.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Census region
definition: Northeast, Midwest, South, West; state-based grouping.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Observed formal AI curriculum
definition: Final binary label: qualifying formal AI/ML teaching content observed in course evidence. All 312 positive extracted text snippets were reviewed by the researcher. No relabeling here.
missing_value_rule: No missing labels; 0 = no qualifying evidence observed.

label: Other-school LEA CS proportion
definition: Other official high schools with >=1 CS class / other official high schools with valid CS reports. Official single-high-school LEAs assigned zero.
source: Full eligible CRDC high-school universe and LEA link
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.
reported_contrast: Other district HS with CS (+10 pp)

label: CS classes per 100 students
definition: 100 * CRDC CS classes / CCD enrollment. Numerator and denominator have different years.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: City vs rural
definition: Locale dummy; rural is the model reference.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Suburb vs rural
definition: Locale dummy; rural is the model reference.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Town vs rural
definition: Locale dummy; rural is the model reference.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Log school enrollment
definition: Natural logarithm of retained total school enrollment.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Charter status
definition: Retained binary charter-school indicator.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: STEM school-name flag
definition: Case-insensitive stem/science/technology/engineering or standalone tech match.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Academy school-name flag
definition: Case-insensitive academy/prep/scholar/governor match.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Student-teacher ratio
definition: Retained students per teacher, capped at 50.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: District BA+ attainment
definition: ACS B15003 categories 022-025 / B15003_001, population aged 25+. Retained geographic-district ACS records joined by LEA key.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Log district household income
definition: Natural logarithm of ACS median household income B19013_001; retained geographic-district ACS records joined by LEA key.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: County technology employment LQ
definition: Retained selected-technology-sector employment location quotient; exact constituent industries/vintage not reconstructed in this package.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: NSLP participation indicator
definition: Retained internal name. Public meaning is National School Lunch Program participation, NOT Title I or independent CEP status. Unreported statuses were retained as zero.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: CS enrollment share
definition: CRDC male+female CS enrollment / same-year male+female total school enrollment. All grades retained in mixed-grade schools.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Data science enrollment indicator
definition: Positive male+female data science enrollment after negative male/female report codes are set to zero; not distance learning.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Log county AI patent density
definition: ln(AI patents per 10,000 residents + 0.01). Missing underlying rates retain ln(0.01), not independently observed zero patent activity.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Fixed broadband availability
definition: Retained 100/20 Mbps availability percentage.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: R1 institution within 25 miles
definition: Retained indicator for an R1 university within 25 miles; distinct from CSRankings proximity.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Log county GDP
definition: Natural logarithm of retained county total GDP.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: CSRankings-linked proximity
definition: -ln(1 + nearest matched institution distance in km). Original name-matched CSRankings/IPEDS measure retained; county-centroid school locations are missing in this regression field.
source: Retained CSRankings-linked campus matching; IPEDS coordinates
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Certified advanced-STEM classes (log)
definition: ln(1 + certified-teacher-taught calculus, physics, and advanced-mathematics classes); counts classes, not teachers.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Archived university distance
definition: Original kilometer distance field, available for 5,131 records. Includes 53 county-centroid fallback locations; do not treat those 53 as eligible school-point regression distances.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Retained latitude
definition: Latitude used by the retained location pipeline; consult precision and school_point_available before mapping school points.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Retained longitude
definition: Longitude used by the retained location pipeline; consult precision and school_point_available before mapping school points.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Location source
definition: Retained location-source category.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Location precision
definition: Retained precision category. county_centroid records do not qualify as school points.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Eligible school point
definition: True for retained eligible school/campus coordinates. 5,078 true; 53 county-centroid false.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: CS enrollment numerator
definition: Retained male+female CS enrollment numerator used in aligned CS share construction.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Same-year school enrollment denominator
definition: Retained male+female total school enrollment denominator for CS share. Includes all school grades.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Grade range category
definition: Retained grade-scope category used to identify mixed-grade schools; not a high-school-only denominator correction.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Structural CS enrollment zero
definition: Flag identifying original structural-zero treatment for no-CS-class reports and zero/negative enrollment fields.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Raw reported CS class count
definition: Source class count. Negative administrative codes are unavailable reports, not no-CS observations.
missing_value_rule: Blank or negative source code = unavailable for CS provision.

label: Certified advanced-STEM class count
definition: Retained unlogged count underlying log_certified_adv_stem_classes.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Official LEA high schools
definition: Eligible official high-school count in the administering LEA.
source: Official CRDC high-school universe and LEA relation
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Valid LEA CS reporters
definition: Eligible official LEA high schools with valid CS class reports.
source: Official CRDC high-school universe and LEA relation
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: LEA CS-offering schools
definition: Eligible official LEA high schools reporting at least one CS class.
source: Official CRDC high-school universe and LEA relation
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: LEA CS reporting coverage
definition: valid_cs_reporters / official_highschools.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Other valid LEA CS reporters
definition: Valid reporting denominator after excluding the focal school where applicable.
source: Official CRDC high-school universe and LEA relation
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Other LEA CS-offering schools
definition: Other high schools reporting at least one CS class; LOO numerator.
source: Official CRDC high-school universe and LEA relation
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Other official LEA high schools
definition: Official LEA high-school count excluding the focal school.
source: Official CRDC high-school universe and LEA relation
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Peer CS reporting coverage
definition: other_valid_cs_reporters / other_official_highschools where the denominator is positive.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Observed CS class provision
definition: 1 = >=1 reported CS class; 0 = reported zero classes; blank = unavailable.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Existing CS descriptive subset
definition: True if CS class count >=1. Use cs_observed_status to distinguish zero from unavailable.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Retained CS provision flag
definition: Administrative binary CS provision field retained in the selected model sample.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Single-high-school LOO zero applied
definition: True when other_official_highschools==0; 1,712 schools in the descriptive sample.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Full-model membership
definition: Exact selected 3,827-school model membership. Recomputed from saved model school IDs, not inherited old model flags.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.

label: Existing-CS model membership
definition: Exact selected 2,900-school model membership.
missing_value_rule: Blank = missing; retained values are not recoded.
